# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `nooks` MCP server pointing at Nooks' hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.nooks.in/mcp`).
- Auth is OAuth against `https://oauth.nooks.in`. Cursor supplies the Nooks OAuth client, so there is no client ID or secret to configure.
- Logo: Nooks' 2026 logo from https://beta.nooks.in/nooks-logo-2026.png.
